title: Ben HaSegan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A Tanna, mentioned in a baraita in [Yoma 44b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.44b.16). See also the entry on [R’ Shimon ben ha-Segan](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3423&lang=en).[^1]

notes.text: [Heilprin’s Ben HaSegan](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=734&lang=en) cites this same baraita. The separate entry on Shimon follows Hyman’s cross-reference and does not establish that they are the same person.
